actions.name: Siege Mode
actions.description: As a full action, the mech reconfigures into a siege configuration. While configured, the mech can't fly, other movement speeds are reduced to 10 feet. The rocket launcher's range increases to 500 feet, its explode radius increases to 20 feet, and it deals medium damage. The mech can end the configuration as a full action.

description.value:
A heavy launcher that fires explosive rockets.

Special: Siege Mode (3 PP) - Fire a devastating shot with increased damage and blast radius.

system.special: explode (10 ft.), unwieldy, siege mode (3 PP)
